name: Fertility
overview: Scripture reveals that fertility is a divine blessing and a vital part of God's design for humanity, as seen in His commands to be fruitful and multiply given to Adam and Noah (Genesis 1:28; 9:1,7). God’s blessing extends beyond human reproduction to include the fruitfulness of the land and livestock, symbolizing comprehensive provision and prosperity (Deuteronomy 7:13). The narrative of Isaac and Rebekah demonstrates God's sovereign power to open the womb and answer prayer for fertility (Genesis 25:21), while Exodus 23:26 promises a land free from barrenness, emphasizing God's care for sustaining life and fulfilling His covenant promises.
